logline: 괴테를 평생 연구한 늙은 학자가 어느 책에서도 찾을 수 없는 괴테의 문장 하나를 좇는 이야기
setting: 오늘의 도쿄 — 책으로 가득한 서재, 대학 도서관 열람실, 조용한 찻집
anchor: an elderly Japanese man of seventy with white hair and round spectacles, in a cardigan over a shirt and tie
palette: off-white, dark brown, dull green, ash grey, dull yellow

beats.beat: 스물세 살의 첫 장편 — 책으로 가득한 방
beats.visual: the study with bookshelves to the ceiling, the desk lamp lit over stacked volumes, the armchair empty, the window showing the quiet street at dusk; no people
beats.motion: the lamp light holds on the stacked volumes while the dusk deepens in the window; the camera holds on the study

beats.visual: the scholar seated at his desk under the green lamp writing in a notebook with a fountain pen, spectacles low on his nose, volumes stacked at his elbow; exactly one man, no readable letters
beats.motion: the scholar's pen moves slowly across the notebook and his spectacles slip a little lower; the camera holds on the man at the desk

beats.visual: the tea room table by the window: a white teacup on its saucer with steam rising, a small blank paper tag on a string lying beside it; no people
beats.motion: steam rises from the teacup and the paper tag stirs slightly in a draft; the camera holds on the cup and the tag

beats.visual: the scholar seated at the tea room table holding the small paper tag up close to his spectacles with both hands, his brow furrowed, the teacup forgotten; exactly one man
beats.motion: the scholar's hands tilt the tag toward the window light and his furrowed brow deepens; the camera holds on the man and the tag

beats.visual: the scholar standing before the bookshelves of his study with one hand resting on a row of old volumes, his head tilted to read the spines, the lamp behind him; exactly one man, no readable letters
beats.motion: the scholar's hand slides slowly along the row of spines and his tilted head follows it; the camera holds on the man at the shelves

beats.visual: the scholar at his desk pressing the small paper tag flat under his palm on the blotter, a thick open volume beside it, his eyes on the tag; exactly one man
beats.motion: the scholar's palm lifts slowly from the tag and his eyes stay fixed on it; the camera holds close on the desk

beats.beat: 어느 책에서도 찾을 수 없는 문장
beats.visual: the scholar pulling volumes off the shelf one after another, a growing stack of open books on the floor and the armchair around him; exactly one man
beats.motion: another volume comes off the shelf into the scholar's hands and the stack on the floor leans a little; the camera holds on the man and the stack

beats.visual: the scholar a small figure at the end of a long table in the library reading room, green lamps in a row, tall stacks rising behind him; exactly one man
beats.motion: the green lamps glow in their row and the small figure turns a page at the far end of the table; the camera holds on the reading room

beats.visual: close on the scholar's wrinkled hand running down the page of an old book on the library table, the green lamp light on the paper; exactly one hand, no readable letters
beats.motion: the wrinkled finger moves slowly down the page and pauses near the bottom; the camera holds close on the hand and the page

beats.visual: the study at night with open books on every surface, the lamp lit, a small framed photograph turned face down on the desk, the window dark; no people
beats.motion: the lamp light holds on the open books and a moth taps at the dark window; the camera holds on the study at night

beats.visual: the scholar standing at the study window with a teacup in both hands looking out at the dawn street, his spectacles pushed up on his forehead; exactly one man
beats.motion: steam rises from the cup as the scholar's eyes follow something down the dawn street; the camera holds on the man at the window

beats.visual: close on the desk: an old leather-bound volume lying open beside a new paperback with a plain cover, the small paper tag between them, the lamp light on all three; no people, no readable letters
beats.motion: the lamp light shifts slowly across the two books and the tag between them holds still; the camera holds close on the desk

beats.visual: the scholar asleep in the armchair of the study with an open book on his chest and his spectacles in his hand, the lamp still lit; exactly one man
beats.motion: the open book rises and sinks slowly on the scholar's chest and the spectacles hang loose in his hand; the camera holds on the sleeping man

beats.visual: the scholar looking up from a book at his desk straight at the camera, his spectacles pushed up and his mouth slightly open, the small paper tag held between two fingers; exactly one man
beats.motion: the scholar's eyes hold on the camera and the tag between his fingers turns slowly; the camera holds close on the man

beats.visual: closing still: the white teacup on its saucer and the small blank paper tag on the desk in morning light, the lamp switched off, the bookshelves behind
beats.motion: morning light creeps slowly across the desk toward the teacup and the tag holds still; the camera closes with great patience on the tag
